Hành động đi lại tự do như Dungeon Quest: Free-roaming action like Dungeon Quest: WASD or arrow keys to move, Space/J/click to slash (auto-aims at the nearest enemy and hits everything in front), Shift/K to dash (brief invincibility), E/Q to drink a potion.
Quái có vòng báo đòn đỏ: né ra khỏi vòng: Monsters show a red warning circle: step out of it or dash in time.
Hạ hết các đợt quái ở mỗi tầng rồi đi tớ: Defeat every wave on each floor, then walk to the glowing chest to descend (pick up a stronger weapon and heal).
The final floor has the Ashen Knight boss.
Điện thoại: chạm kéo bên trái để di chuy: On phones: touch and drag on the left to move, and use the buttons below to slash, dash and drink potions.
Move with WASD, slash with Space.
